answer.question: What does TEAM International offer as an engineering staffing agency?
answer.text: TEAM International is an engineering staffing agency and technology partner for construction, energy and industrial companies. We supply pre-vetted engineers, project managers and skilled specialists with full HR, payroll and compliance support, and add digital engineering teams and field technology when your projects need them.
answer.segmentsIntro: Engineering staffing companies are not all alike: we focus on mid-size and enterprise programs that need specialists fast and keep them for years.
segments: Energy, oil and gas and utilities

items.q: What do engineering staffing services include?
items.a: Engineering staffing services cover finding, assessing, hiring and administering engineers and technical specialists for your projects. As an engineering staffing firm, TEAM International also handles HR, payroll and compliance, and can add digital engineering teams when projects need software, data or BIM work.

Civil, mechanical, electrical, power and grid engineers; project and program managers; site engineers and safety specialists; cost engineers; construction coordinators and superintendents; skilled trades; and software, data, AI and BIM specialists.

items.q: How fast can you deploy engineers?
items.a: Typically in weeks instead of months, because we source from pre-vetted pools and run assessments before you interview. Exact timing depends on the role, certifications and location.

items.q: Do you staff energy, oil and gas and utility projects?
items.a: Yes. We staff energy programs and also build software for the sector, including an asset-management application for a global energy technology company and regulator reporting for an oil and gas producer.

items.q: What is the difference between engineering staffing and engineering staff augmentation?
items.a: Engineering staffing places individual specialists or crews for your projects; engineering staff augmentation adds a managed team that works inside your organization on an ongoing basis. TEAM offers both, plus project-based contract engineering services.

items.q: Why is it so hard to hire engineers and skilled workers?
items.a: Demand is outpacing supply. ABC estimates the U.S. construction industry must attract about 349,000 net new workers in 2026, and ManpowerGroup's 2026 survey found that 69% of U.S. employers have difficulty finding the talent they need.

items.q: Do you only provide people, or technology too?
items.a: Both. Alongside staffing we build field service software, IoT monitoring and automation for engineering-driven companies, so the same partner can close today's workforce gap and reduce tomorrow's.
With a workforce needs assessment. From there we agree a staffing plan, role profiles and timelines, and start sourcing from our pre-vetted pools.
